stem.text: A cell of constant electromotive force (e.m.f.) but with internal resistance is connected to a fixed resistor $R$ using a potentiometer. A voltmeter measures the potential difference (p.d.) between the terminals of the cell.

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit: a voltmeter V connected across a cell, with a resistor drawn between ends X and a sliding contact Z, and a separate resistor labelled R.

stem.text: Which statement explains the change to the reading of the voltmeter as contact Z is moved towards end X of the potentiometer?

A.text: The voltmeter reading decreases because the current through the cell decreases.

B.text: The voltmeter reading decreases because the current through the cell increases.

C.text: The voltmeter reading increases because the current through the cell decreases.

D.text: The voltmeter reading increases because the current through the cell increases.
